question: In September 2020, an MoU was signed between the Ministry of AYUSH and Ministry of Women and Child Development for controlling:
solution:
The correct answer is __**malnutrition**__.__**​**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On September 20, 2020, the Ministry of Ayush and Ministry of Women and Child Development signed a Memorandum of Understanding to control malnutrition in the country.
 
• The agreement was signed as a part of Poshan Abhiyaan.
 
• The MoU will help in tackling the problem of malnutrition in mothers and children in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Malnutrition**:

 
 
• Malnutrition is a condition when a person’s diet does not provide enough nutrients or the right balance of nutrients for optimal good health.
 
• It also refers to deficiencies, excesses, or imbalances in a person’s intake of energy and nutrients.
 
• The term malnutrition addresses 3 broad groups of conditions:
 
 
• **Undernutrition** includes three types:
 
 
• **wasting (low weight-for-height)**
 
• **stunting (low height-for-age)**
 
• **underweight (low weight-for-age).**
